sources.cli: NWS CLI via IEM (data/raw/iem/cli/*_cli.csv, column high) for NYC/EWR/TTN/MDW/MIA; IEM ASOS daily.py max_temp_f (data/raw/iem/{LGA,JFK,ORD,FLL,OPF}.csv) as the CLI stand-in for the other location sites (docs/CONVENTIONS.md section 8). vintageHash = sha256 of the source CSV row.
sources.ladders: Kalshi KXHIGHNY/KXHIGHCHI/KXHIGHMIA markets + hourly candles (data/cache/kalshi/{markets,candles}.parquet); candle ts = end_period_ts; ask/bid dollars -> cents half up. No recorded books in the window: hedge fills use the candle rule (SPEC 7.2).
sources.rain: Kalshi KXRAIN daily '> 0 in' binaries for NYC/CHI/MIA (data/cache/kalshi/kxrain_{markets,candles}.parquet, scripts/pull_kxrain.py) + NWS CLI daily precip at CLINYC/CLIORD/CLIMIA (data/raw/iem/cli, data/cache/eval03/cli/ORD_2026.csv); trace kept as a flag; vintageHash = sha256 of the CSV row.
sources.weather: NWS CLI via IEM: high (F), precip (in, T = 0), snow (in, T = 0, M = null)
